'''Vault of the Mother Machine''' was one of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vaults in the [[Cells of the Lords of the Infinite]], a section of [[the Tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The vault housed the [[Mother Machine]], a device with which the Rakata sought to restore their [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vault of the Mother Machine appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Belsavis.
